requests.title: Compound duration output option for ms format
requests.firstAsk: Nice. Add tests for it and commit.
requests.summary: Adds a compound output option to ms format (e.g. 1h 30m), with tests and README docs. The format still has to be changed to be Go time.ParseDuration-compatible (e.g. 25h30m).
conversationAsks: Change of plan on the compound format. The deploy logs it's meant for get scraped by a Go service that runs every duration through `time.ParseDuration`, and that rejects spaces and has no `d` unit. So compound output has to be ParseDuration-compatible: parts glued together and hours as the biggest unit, e.g. `25h30m` rather than `1d 1h 30m`. Don't change it right now though, something more urgent…
Nice. Add tests for it and commit.
Let's wrap up the compound format option: document it in the README and round out the tests so it's ready for review.
